counterfactual_text: The stationary blue ball starts moving away before the red ball reaches it; the red ball slows and contact occurs afterward.
positive_text: The red ball visibly contacts the stationary blue ball; the blue ball then moves away as the red ball slows.
semantic_text: A red billiard ball rolls into a stationary blue billiard ball; after contact, the blue ball moves away while the red ball slows. Required visible entities: one red billiard ball; one blue billiard ball; level billiard-table surface. At the beginning: red ball: separated from the blue ball on the same table; blue ball: stationary and separated from the red ball. Required state changes: red ball position: approaches and contacts the blue ball; red ball speed: rolling to slower; blue ball speed: stationary to moving away. These event variables are allowed to change: red ball position and speed; blue ball position and speed; distance between the balls. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; billiard-table appearance; red and blue ball identities; one red billiard ball; one blue billiard ball; the same billiard table and ball identities.
